packages.name: Foundation Management
packages.description: Professional management of your primary social channel including publishing, basic moderation, and monthly performance tracking.
packages.idealCustomer: Small businesses wanting a well-tended, responsive social media channel without overhead.
features: Management of 1 core social platform (Instagram or LinkedIn)
3 curated posts per week (12 posts / 4 weeks)
Basic comment and DM inbox triage (Business days)

packages.name: Growth Management
packages.description: Active multi-channel management designed to build community, engage prospects, and drive qualified inquiries.
packages.idealCustomer: Growing brands looking to turn their social channels into active community-building and lead-generation funnels.
features: Management of 2 social platforms (e.g. Instagram & LinkedIn or TikTok)
5 high-engagement posts per week (20 posts / 4 weeks)
Proactive daily community engagement (Interacting with target accounts & industry hashtags)
Comment responses & direct message lead qualification
Weekly interactive story updates (Polls, Q&As, announcements)
Monthly strategic review call & content performance breakdown
deliverables: Monthly Strategic Performance Video Call (45 mins)

packages.name: Omnichannel Brand Leadership

features: Comprehensive management across up to 4 platforms
Rapid response community moderation (Under 2-hour response during business hours)
Bi-weekly strategy reviews & dedicated Slack/WhatsApp channel
Competitor benchmark tracking and trend hijacking

Daily Active Community Building & Rapid Inbox Management
Executive Social Media KPI Dashboard & ROI Reporting
